SYSTEM_INFO_RESET_WARNING: WARNING! This permanently deletes your current settings. This will also restart the Steam client, no Steam data will be affected.
SYSTEM_INFO_REINSTALL_TIME: Reinstall can take up to 1 minute
SYSTEM_INFO_UPDATE_TIME: Update can take up to 1 minute
SYSTEM_INFO_DETECT_AMD_UNDERVOLT_DESC: Check if your device supports ryzenadj-based CPU undervolting. If it does, you should see a toggle appear in the advanced options. This will reboot Steam.
ADVANCED_ENABLE_TDP_CONTROLS_DESC: Enable TDP slider and other advanced options
ADVANCED_ENABLE_MANUAL_CPU_CONTROLS_DESC: Enable manual CPU boost, SMT, power governor, and EPP controls
ADVANCED_ENABLE_SIMPLE_EPP_LABELS_DESC: Enable more intuitive labels for EPP and power governor
ADVANCED_ENABLE_AUTO_CPU_MANAGEMENT_DESC: Enable automatic management of CPU boost, EPP, SMT, and governor
ADVANCED_ENABLE_AC_POWER_PROFILES: Enable per-game AC Power TDP Profiles
ADVANCED_ENABLE_AC_POWER_PROFILES_DESC: Use separate per-game TDP profiles when connected to AC power. Requires per-game profiles to be enabled
MAX_TDP_ON_AC_POWER: Always use Max TDP on AC power
MAX_TDP_ON_AC_POWER_DESC: When plugged into AC power, always use max TDP. Per-game profiles must be enabled
ADVANCED_ENABLE_BACKGROUND_POLLING_DESC: Polling sets TDP every few seconds
ADVANCED_FORCE_DISABLE_TDP_ON_RESUME_DES: Disable automatic TDP setting on resume from sleep
ADVANCED_FORCE_DISABLE_SUSPEND_ACTIONS_D: Disable all suspend-related changes when putting device to sleep
ADVANCED_MAX_TDP_ON_RESUME_DESC: Temporarily set TDP to maximum for X seconds when resuming from sleep
ADVANCED_RYZENADJ_UNDERVOLT_DESC: Warning, use with caution. ryzenadj --set-coall flag value
ADVANCED_TEMP_MAX_TDP_PROFILE_DESC: Temporarily set TDP to maximum for X seconds when launching a game
ADVANCED_FORCE_OVERRIDE_MAX_TDP_DESC: Warning, only use if you know what you are doing. Sets max TDP limit to 120W
ADVANCED_DECK_ENABLE_TDP_ADJUSTMENT_DESC: Warning, requires custom BIOS for Steam Deck
ADVANCED_DECK_ENABLE_CUSTOM_GPU_CLOCK_DE: Warning, requires custom BIOS for Steam Deck
ADVANCED_ASUS_EXTREME_POWERSAVE_DESC: Reduces power consumption during sleep. Warning, requires updated MCU firmware and updated Asus-Linux kernel module
ADVANCED_ASUS_USE_WMI_DESC: Use Asus WMI calls instead of ryzenadj
REMAP_WARNING: ⚠️ WARNING ⚠️ - Don't use these remapping features with Controller Emulators. If you are using Handheld Daemon (hhd), use the Dualsense Edge controller + remap back buttons with Steam Input
ADVANCED_ENABLE_EGPU_POWER_PROFILES_DESC: Use separate per-game TDP profiles when connected to an external GPU (eGPU). Takes precedence over AC and battery profiles. Requires per-game profiles to be enabled
FAN_THERMAL_SAFETY: Thermal Safety (Enable max fan speed if 80°C is exceeded)
OPTISCALER_INSTRUCTION_TEXT:
Use 'Copy launch options' for the standard direct launch-options method. If you want the wrapper commands instead, enable Manual Mode to reveal 'Copy Patch Command' and 'Copy Unpatch Command'.

In-game: Enable DLSS in graphics settings to unlock FSR 3.1/XeSS 2.0 in DirectX12 Games.

For extended OptiScaler options, assign a back button to a keyboard's 'Insert' key.
OPTISCALER_MANUAL_MODE_DESC: Show wrapper command clipboard buttons for patching and unpatching through ~/fgmod scripts.
OPTISCALER_ADVANCED_MODE_DESC_ON: Manually apply OptiScaler to a specific game directory.
OPTISCALER_ADVANCED_MODE_DESC_OFF: Install OptiScaler first to enable manual patching.
OPTISCALER_SELECT_DIRECTORY_DESC: Choose the game's installation directory (where the EXE lives).
OPTISCALER_TARGET_DIRECTORY_DESC: OptiScaler files will be copied here.
OPTISCALER_PATCH_MODAL_DESC: WARNING: LeGO Suite does not unpatch games when uninstalled. Be sure to unpatch the game or run the OptiScaler uninstall script inside the game files if you choose to uninstall the plugin or the game has issues.
OPTISCALER_ENABLE_FG_MODAL_DESC: Important: This plugin does not automatically unpatch games when uninstalled. If you uninstall this plugin or experience game issues, use the 'Disable Frame Generation' option or verify game file integrity through Steam.
OPTISCALER_FG_ENABLED_MSG: Frame generation enabled for {name}. Launch the game, enable DLSS in graphics settings, then press Insert to access OptiScaler options.
OPTISCALER_FG_DISABLED_UNIFIDECK_MSG: Frame generation disabled for {name} (unpatched game folder & preserved Unifideck store token).
OPTISCALER_FG_DISABLED_STEAM_MSG: Frame generation will be disabled on next launch of {name}.
OPTISCALER_DLL_DXGI_HINT: Works for most DX12 games. Default.
OPTISCALER_DLL_WINMM_HINT: Use when dxgi.dll conflicts with an existing game file.
OPTISCALER_DLL_VERSION_HINT: Common fallback; works well with many launchers.
OPTISCALER_DLL_DBGHELP_HINT: Use for debug helper hook paths.
OPTISCALER_DLL_WINHTTP_HINT: Use when other DLL names conflict.
OPTISCALER_DLL_WININET_HINT: Use when other DLL names conflict.
OPTISCALER_DLL_ASI_HINT: For ASI loaders. Requires an ASI loader already installed in the game.
OPTISCALER_FSR4_RDNA23_HINT: Older compatible runtime for RDNA2/3. In most cases, use the Valve 4.1.1 path for RDNA2 or the regular 4.1.1 driver override.
OPTISCALER_FSR4_RDNA4_HINT: Uses OptiScaler 0.9.4's bundled FSR4.1.1 SDK upscaler. Official FSR4 support is RDNA4 (FP8) and RDNA3 desktop GPUs (INT8).
OPTISCALER_FSR4_RDNA34_HINT: Uses the final bundled FSR4.1.1 SDK upscaler plus the separately bundled 4.1.1 amdxcffx64.dll driver override.
OPTISCALER_FSR4_RDNA2_VALVE_HINT: Uses the final bundled FSR4.1.1 SDK upscaler with the existing pre10 injector, Valve 4.1.1 amdxcffx64.dll, amdxc64.dll, and RDNA2-specific INI overrides.
